headline: Poziotinib shows high wild-type EGFR binding potency in vitro (rank 2 of 13), but no preclinical functional, clinical or safety evidence was retrieved, so this does not show it will work in NSCLC.

sections.summary: Across pooled wild-type EGFR IC50 binding data, poziotinib ranks 2 of 13 by median pChEMBL, behind mobocertinib, which has only 2 measurements. In two matched assays, poziotinib was above afatinib in one and equal to gefitinib in the other. Ranks come from different assays and labs and are indicative only. The target was auto-selected and is not a recorded mechanism target for poziotinib (ChEMBL records the mechanism on a protein family). Mutant-variant measurements were excluded from the ranking, so it says little about mutant-driven NSCLC.

claims.text: Poziotinib has 5 comparable IC50 binding measurements on EGFR, with median pChEMBL 9.48 (range 9.4–9.86), ranking 2 of 13 by median.
Mobocertinib ranks 1 of 13 with median pChEMBL 10.65 (range 10.6–10.7), but from only 2 measurements, so its ranking is uncertain.
Afatinib ranks 3 of 13 (median pChEMBL 8.86, 10 measurements shown, range 7.52–10.1), below poziotinib by median.
Matched assay CHEMBL5255141 (wild type EGFR, unknown origin): poziotinib pChEMBL 9.86 versus afatinib 9.19.
Matched assay CHEMBL5638814 (ADP-glo kinase assay, wild type GST-tagged EGFR): poziotinib pChEMBL 9.6 and gefitinib 9.6, i.e. equal in this assay.
Gefitinib ranks 9 of 13 (median pChEMBL 7.69) and erlotinib 10 of 13 (median 7.58) in the pooled data, but these rankings span many assays and wide ranges.
Binding potency on isolated wild-type EGFR does not establish clinical efficacy or safety; poziotinib is not shown here to be better than approved drugs in patients.

sections.summary: No functional, cell-based or in vivo evidence was retrieved yet.
Clinical trial data was not yet retrieved for this report.
Computed properties only, calculated by ChEMBL. These are NOT a safety assessment. No drug warnings were listed.

claims.text: Computed properties for poziotinib: MW 491.35, AlogP 5.38, 1 Lipinski Ro5 violation, QED 0.37.

openQuestions: How does poziotinib compare with comparators in matched assays against clinically relevant mutant EGFR variants (e.g. exon 20 insertions, L858R,T790M)? Mutant data were excluded from the ranking.
Is the potency seen on isolated wild-type EGFR reflected in cell-based or in vivo models?
What selectivity does poziotinib show against wild-type EGFR relative to mutant forms, and against other kinases?
What efficacy and safety have been reported in clinical trials in NSCLC?
Are the 5 measurements consistent given they come from different assays and labs?
nextSteps: Retrieve and review clinical trial data for poziotinib in non-small cell lung cancer.
Retrieve cell-based and in vivo functional evidence, including mutant EGFR models.
Build matched-assay comparisons against mutant EGFR variants relevant to NSCLC.
Review selectivity and any available drug warnings or adverse-event data.
